blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Durga Puja of Kolkata was inscribed on UNESCO's Representative List of the Intangible Cultural Heritage of Humanity in December 2021.
Gangasagar Mela, held annually on Sagar Island during Makar Sankranti, is considered the second largest religious gathering in India after Kumbh Mela.
Poush Mela is an annual fair and festival held in Santiniketan, Birbhum, celebrating rural crafts, Baul music, and the foundation day of the Brahma Mandir.
Rash Mela in Cooch Behar is one of the oldest and most prominent heritage festivals of North Bengal, dedicated to Lord Krishna.
Gambhira, Jhumar, and Chhau are iconic traditional folk dance and music forms integral to West Bengal's regional cultural identity.
Gangasagar Mela is situated at the confluence of the Hooghly River and the Bay of Bengal in the South 24 Parganas district.
Poush Mela commences on the 7th day of the Bengali month of Poush, commemorating Maharshi Debendranath Tagore's acceptance of Brahmoism.
Gambhira folk performance and festival is historically and culturally associated primarily with Malda district.
